summary: Houndarr automates scheduled backlog searches across media management tools like Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr, Readarr, and Whisparr. It processes missing and cutoff-unmet items in small, rate-limited batches with hourly caps and item cooldowns to prevent indexer overload.
goodFor: Users managing large media libraries who frequently trigger rate limits or blocks on their private and public indexers during automated backlog searches.
watchOut: The project shows slowing maintenance activity with a moderate health score, meaning you may encounter unpatched bugs or slow updates.
deployNotes: You can deploy this software using Docker, which typically requires persistent volumes for configuration storage and appropriate environment variables to communicate with your existing media stack instances.
